title.ko: 연애의 시작을 서로 다르게 말할 때
title.de: Den Anfang einer Beziehung unterschiedlich erinnern
title.en: Remembering the start of a relationship differently

intro.ko: 크리스티안이 친구들 앞에서 첫눈에 시작됐다고 농담하자 수진은 쌓인 시간이 지워진 것처럼 느껴요.
intro.de: Christian scherzt vor Freunden, alles habe mit Liebe auf den ersten Blick begonnen; Sujin fühlt sich um die langsam gewachsene Nähe gebracht.
intro.en: Christian jokes that it was love at first sight, while Sujin feels that erases the trust that grew over time.

scenario.intent: 낭만적 농담의 의도와 상대가 잃었다고 느낀 서사를 조정한다

vocab.korean: 아까 친구들 앞에서 첫눈에 반했다고 말한 거, 저는 조금 불편했어요.

note.de: Dein Spruch vorhin, du hättest dich auf den ersten Blick verliebt, war mir etwas unangenehm.
note.en: I felt a little uncomfortable when you told our friends it was love at first sight.

vocab.korean: 그냥 이야기를 짧고 재미있게 하려고 한 말이었어요.

note.de: Ich wollte die Geschichte nur kurz und lustig erzählen.
note.en: I was just trying to make the story short and funny.

vocab.korean: 저한테는 처음보다 그 뒤에 천천히 믿게 된 시간이 더 중요해요.

note.de: Für mich ist die Zeit danach wichtiger, in der Vertrauen langsam gewachsen ist.
note.en: To me, the time afterward, when trust grew slowly, matters more than the first moment.

vocab.korean: 첫눈에 시작됐다는 말이 우리 사이에 쌓인 시간을 지우는 것처럼 들렸구나.

note.de: „Liebe auf den ersten Blick“ klang also, als würde es die Zeit auslöschen, die wir miteinander aufgebaut haben.
note.en: Saying it began at first sight sounded like it erased all the time we built together.

vocab.korean: 네. 그 기억이 틀렸다는 게 아니라 그게 전부인 것처럼 말하지 않았으면 해요.

note.de: Ja. Deine Erinnerung ist nicht falsch; ich möchte nur nicht, dass sie als die ganze Geschichte gilt.
note.en: Yes. Your memory isn't wrong. I just don't want it told as the whole story.

vocab.korean: 다음에는 저는 처음의 설렘을, 수진은 그 뒤의 신뢰를 중요하게 기억한다고 말할게요.

note.de: Dann sage ich künftig: Für mich war die erste Aufregung wichtig, für dich das Vertrauen, das danach entstand.
note.en: Next time I'll say I remember the early spark, while you value the trust that came afterward.

explanation.ko: 이 장면의 실제 대사에서 쓰인 표현이에요.
explanation.en: In order to (the goal of an action)
